battleTraits.name: Heavens-sent
battleTraits.effect: Heavens-sent (Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase): Set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) more than 9" from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: Their Finest Hour
battleTraits.effect: Their Finest Hour (Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase): For the rest of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for that unit's combat attacks and add 1 to save rolls for that unit.

battleTraits.name: Scions of the Storm
battleTraits.effect: Scions of the Storm (Your Movement Phase): Set up that unit anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: The Celestial Realm
battleTraits.effect: The Celestial Realm (Deployment Phase): Set up that unit in reserve in the Celestial Realm. It has now been deployed.

artefacts.name: Null Pendant
artefacts.effect: Null Pendant: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target. Subtract 5 from the target's control score for the rest of the turn.

artefacts.name: Quicksilver Draught
artefacts.effect: Quicksilver Draught: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase This unit has Strike-first for the rest of the turn.

artefacts.name: Mirrorshield
artefacts.effect: Mirrorshield: This unit cannot be targeted by shooting attacks unless the attacking model is within 9" of it.

artefacts.name: Beacon of Azyr
artefacts.effect:
Beacon of Azyr: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase Pick a visible friendly Stormcast Eternals Wizard or Priest wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. The next time this turn that the target uses a Prayer or Spell ability, instead of making a casting roll or chanting roll for them, you can use a value of 7 for the roll that cannot be modified. After that ability is resolved, if the target has any ritual points, reset their ritual points total to 0.
Designer's Note: *Ritual points apply modifiers so cannot be used with this ability to increase the chanting roll to more than 7.*

artefacts.name: Sigil of Morrda
artefacts.effect: Sigil of Morrda: Once Per Turn, Reaction: Opponent declared a command or a Rampage ability for a unit in combat with this unit Roll a dice. On a 3+, that command or Rampage ability has no effect, it still counts as having been used and any command points spent to use that ability are still lost.

artefacts.name: Banner of Sigmar
artefacts.effect: Banner of Sigmar: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase Pick an objective within 18" of this unit to be the target.

artefacts.name: Pennant of Azyrite Majesty
artefacts.effect:
Pennant of Azyrite Majesty: Start of Any Turn Pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit to be the enemy target, then you can pick a friendly Stormcast Eternals unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the friendly target Spend 1 rage dice. If your opponent's fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7. Then, for the rest of the turn, while it is visible to this unit:
• Subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for the enemy target.
• Add 1 to casting rolls and chanting rolls for the friendly target.

artefacts.name: Blade of the Six Smiths
artefacts.effect:
Blade of the Six Smiths: Any Combat Phase Pick 1 of this unit's non-Companion melee weapons to be the target. For the rest of the turn:
• Halve the Attacks characteristic of the target weapon (rounding up).
• Double the Damage characteristic of the target weapon.
• Attacks made with the target weapon score critical hits on unmodified hit rolls of 3+.

artefacts.name: Fractured Astral Jewel
artefacts.effect: Fractured Astral Jewel: If an ability would heal or return any slain models to an enemy unit while it is within 6" of this unit, that ability does not heal any damage points or return any slain models to it.

heroicTraits.name: Staunch Defender
heroicTraits.effect: Staunch Defender: While this unit is contesting an objective in friendly territory, add 3 to the control scores of friendly Stormcast Eternals units contesting that objective.

heroicTraits.name: Envoy of the Heavens
heroicTraits.effect: Envoy of the Heavens: Your Hero Phase If a friendly Stormcast Eternals unit was destroyed in the previous turn, pick a visible friendly Stormcast Eternals unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target. The target has Ward (5+) until the start of your next turn.

heroicTraits.name: Shock and Awe
heroicTraits.effect:
Shock and Awe: Each time this unit is set up using the 'Scions of the Storm' ability, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit for the rest of the battle round.
In addition, each time a friendly Stormcast Eternals unit is set up wholly within 12" of this unit using the 'Scions of the Storm' ability, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target that unit for the rest of the battle round.

heroicTraits.name: Intense Piety
heroicTraits.effect: Intense Piety: Your Hero Phase Pick a visible enemy Priest or Wizard within 18" of this unit to be the target. Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from casting rolls and chanting rolls for the target until the start of your next turn.

heroicTraits.name: Legendary Tenacity
heroicTraits.effect: Legendary Tenacity: The first time this unit would be destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a dice. On a 3+, this unit is not destroyed and any remaining damage points inflicted on it have no effect. Then, Heal (D3) this unit.

heroicTraits.name: Hour of Glory
heroicTraits.effect: Hour of Glory: This unit can be picked to use the 'Their Finest Hour' ability even if it has already used it this battle. In addition, when this unit is picked to use the 'Their Finest Hour' ability, add 5 to its control score for the rest of the turn.

battleFormations.name: Vanguard Wing
battleFormations.effect: Peerless Manoeuvres: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase Pick a friendly Vanguard Chamber unit that did not use a Move ability this turn and is not in combat. Roll a dice. On a 3+, remove that unit from the battlefield and set it up again anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy units.

battleFormations.name: Sentinels of the Bleak Citadels
battleFormations.effect: Ancient Aura: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase Pick a friendly Ruination Chamber unit. That unit has Ward (5+) for the rest of the turn.

battleFormations.name: Thunderhead Host
battleFormations.effect: Synchronised Strikes: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly Warrior Chamber units while they are wholly within 12" of any friendly non-Hero non-Beast Stormcast Eternals units that do not have the Warrior Chamber keyword.

battleFormations.name: Lightning Echelon
battleFormations.effect: Oncoming Storm: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase Pick a friendly Extremis Chamber unit that charged this turn. Roll a dice. On a 3+, that unit has Strike-first for the rest of the turn.

battleFormations.name: Sacrosanct Convocation
battleFormations.effect: Cycle of the Storm: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Your Turn Pick a friendly Sacrosanct Chamber unit that had models slain in this turn to be the target. Return 1 slain model to the target unit.
